Type-1 Zoning Map Amendment
For 2032-2034 W Ohio
From RS-3 to RT-4

1.A. The applicant seeks a zoning change from RS-3 to RT-4 to meet the bulk and density
standards of an RT-4 district to allow an existing non-compliant single family home to be
brought into compliance and to allow the renovation of an existing 2" floor terrace with a
pool, a hot tub and a pergola.
